mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stay (room_id, channel_id, check_in_at, expected_check_out_at, status, remark) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{channelId}, #{checkInAt}, #{expectedCheckOutAt}, 1, #{remark})
INSERT INTO stay_guest (stay_id, name, gender, id_card, is_main) VALUES (#{stayId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{idCard}, #{isMain})
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id AS roomId, channel_id AS channelId, check_in_at AS checkInAt, expected_check_out_at AS expectedCheckOutAt, check_out_at AS checkOutAt, status, remark FROM stay WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stay SET status = 2, check_out_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
